evidence.text: Which exact static, spherically symmetric charged-fluid solutions exist with a cosmological constant, what compactness restrictions follow within the chosen family, and which electrovac exteriors or closed two-center configurations do they require?

evidence.text: Can a rotating black hole remain in equilibrium with an exterior scalar condensate? The imported construction uses synchronized rotation and connects solitonic rotating stars to a restricted Kerr scalar-cloud boundary.

evidence.text: Does cosmic censorship exclude physically problematic five-dimensional AdS–Kerr geometries, and can superradiance, brane nucleation, or an additional holographic mass bound eliminate the remaining large-specific-angular-momentum cases?

evidence.text: How does the Goroff–Sagnotti Weyl-cube deformation change spherical vacuum geometries, Schwarzschild horizons and their structural stability?

evidence.text: Can classical Einstein–Maxwell theory admit extended spherical objects with gravitational mass m<|Q|, and can their evolution avoid naked singularities while supporting trapped gravitational perturbations?

sources.title: Black holes and wormholes in (2+1)-dimensions

evidence.text: Which black-hole spacetimes arise from discrete AdS3 identifications with time-symmetric initial data and one asymptotic region, and how do interior topology, horizon formation, trapped curves and topological censorship behave?

sources.title: Entropy and mass bounds of Kerr-de Sitter spacetimes

evidence.text: How does rotation affect Kerr–de Sitter boundary mass, angular momentum, cosmological-horizon entropy and the c-function? Does this family respect the N-bound and maximal mass conjecture, and can boundary mass diagnose the absence of cosmological singularities?

sources.title: Entropy of rotating Misner string space-times

evidence.text: Can an intrinsic boundary counterterm prescription assign finite energy, angular momentum and entropy to rotating four-dimensional Kerr–NUT/bolt geometries, including AdS and asymptotically locally flat cases, without reference-background subtraction?

sources.title: Breaking an Abelian gauge symmetry near a black hole horizon

evidence.text: Locate marginally stable modes along selected parameter curves rather than construct the nonlinear condensed phase. For m²>0 require ψ→0 at infinity; for negative m² use the AdS source-free boundary condition associated with a selected operator dimension.

sources.title: Charged perfect fluids in the presence of a cosmological constant

evidence.text: The coordinate r=R sinχ removes the areal-coordinate obstruction at the equator. Matching to charged Nariai is performed in Gaussian normal coordinates by imposing continuity of the metric and its first normal derivative, giving a linear system for exterior constants.

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: Differentiate the potential in field space, establish an amplitude-dependent lower bound, evaluate each profile's maximum, and locate threshold crossings. Compare those crossings with independently determined mass turning points, fission diagnostics, and light rings.

sources.title: Cosmic censorship for AdS5-Kerr

evidence.text: Express horizon existence through roots of Δ_r, then translate the geometric inequality into physical mass and specific angular momentum using Ξ. Analyze the two roots of a quadratic to determine the censorship-allowed branches.

sources.title: The fate of horizons under quantum corrections

evidence.text: Apply the principle of symmetric criticality to the spherical metric. Factor its Weyl tensor as W=G·C, with C depending on metric components but not their derivatives, and use the trace equation to constrain pure-Weyl solutions.

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture, overcharged shells and gravitational traps

evidence.text: Shell motion is rewritten as a one-dimensional potential problem with an initial-value constraint. Axial exterior perturbations use Reissner–Nordström master potentials and tortoise coordinates; the interior gravitational potential is l(l+1)/R².

sources.title: Interiors of singularity-free rotating black holes

evidence.text: Within the Gürses–Gürsey class of regular rotating metrics, when can observers cross the disk or ring without introducing negative-r regions, and what follows for curvature regularity, effective matter, causality and global structure?

sources.title: Properties of a recent quantum extension of the Kruskal geometry

evidence.text: For a previously proposed LQG-inspired effective extension of Schwarzschild–Kruskal spacetime, are the horizon temperature, interior–exterior matching, asymptotic geometry and energy definitions physically satisfactory despite unusual curvature falloff?

sources.title: Charged black holes in Einsteinian cubic gravity and nonuniqueness

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional Einsteinian cubic gravity minimally coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics support distinct asymptotically flat black holes with identical mass and charge, and how do their horizons, thermodynamics and horizonless counterparts behave?

sources.title: Scalar lumps with two horizons

evidence.text: What global geometries and existence limits arise for static, spherically symmetric scalar lumps with two horizons, and can their Euclidean continuations be smoothly attached to an exterior vacuum spacetime for black hole seeded decay?

sources.title: Classical and thermodynamic stability of black branes

evidence.text: Under what assumptions does local thermodynamic instability imply a classical Gregory–Laflamme instability, and conversely, for black branes with noncompact translational symmetry? Does the instability disappear in a finite neighborhood of extremality?

sources.title: Stringy black holes and energy conditions

evidence.text: Which dilaton and dilaton–Maxwell black holes satisfy local or averaged energy conditions, in which domains and frames, and what does this establish about geodesic focusing and the applicability of singularity theorems?

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Can RN-AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence and a string cloud satisfy the paper's weak-gravity charge-to-mass criterion while retaining a horizon at a restricted-phase-space thermodynamic critical point?

sources.title: Horizonless black hole mimickers with spin

evidence.text: Can a rotating horizonless black shell be constructed with a physically motivated surface stress tensor, and what exterior multipoles, fluid flows, and stability properties distinguish this model from Kerr?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: What uncertainty remains when exterior measurements specify a black hole's mass, charge, and angular momentum but cannot distinguish its internal configuration or formation history?

sources.title: Violation of Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory: singularities connected by traversable wormholes

evidence.text: Can analytic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton solutions furnish positive-mass naked singularities, singularity pairs with a traversable connection, and a nonsingular dyonic limit? What charges, weak-gravity diagnostic and light deflection follow?

sources.title: Massless black holes and charged wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can special integration constants of the dyonic Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton solution produce individual zero-ADM-mass objects and a static charged Einstein–Rosen bridge, and what field pathologies and energy-condition qualifications accompany them?

sources.title: Scalar lumps with a horizon

evidence.text: Which spherically symmetric Einstein–scalar configurations have a regular origin surrounded by a horizon, and what additional geometries appear when the areal radius is allowed to turn around?

sources.title: Cosmic-quantum connections: Assessing the viability of weak gravity and weak cosmic censorship conjectures in Kerr-Newman-Kiselev-Letelier black hole

evidence.text: Can spin, a string cloud, and a quintessence term permit horizon-bearing extremal Kerr–Newman–Kiselev–Letelier configurations with Q²/M²>1, which the authors interpret as compatible with both the mild weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: dS$_{4}$ universe emergent from Kerr-AdS$_{5}$ spacetime: bubble nucleation catalyzed by a black hole

evidence.text: Can a vacuum bubble nucleated around a rotating AdS5 black hole support quasi-dS4 cosmology, and how do rotation, black-hole regularity and competing superradiance constrain nucleation and its rate?

sources.title: Exploration of a singular fluid spacetime

evidence.text: What singularity, perturbation, tidal-response and geodesic properties characterize relativistic singular isothermal spheres, and can their Einstein–dilaton realization connect naked singularities to the swampland distance conjecture?
